title: Five scholars recognized at ABRCMS
text: MSP recognized Amirah, Isley, Giselle, Isaiah, and Kaelonnah for their research presentations at ABRCMS 2025.

title: Summer research presentations at MIT
text: David (Cohort 10) and Valeria (Cohort 9) participated in the MIT Summer Research Program and presented their research in August 2025.

title: Matias Moreno: energy research and peer mentoring
text: Materials science and engineering scholar Matias Moreno researched fuel cell catalyst layers at Berkeley Lab during summer 2025. Penn State’s research mentoring office also highlighted his role as an Undergraduate Research Ambassador, supporting students with research mentors, posters, and REU applications.

title: Scholar voices at TEDxPSU 2026
text: Sofia spoke about the importance of ethical research in Indigenous communities at TEDxPSU 2026. Kieran and Marisa helped organize the event, bringing scholar perspectives to both the stage and the planning team.

title: Scholars supporting young readers
text: Millennium Scholars participated in the African American Read-In at Park Forest Elementary, connecting their commitment to community service with local students.

title: Giving Tuesday 2025: $38,580 raised
text: MSP reported that 102 donors helped raise $38,580 and unlock a $5,000 challenge gift during its completed Giving Tuesday campaign. The program thanked supporters for helping fund research, conference presentations, and student success.
